summary_en: Oenon Holdings raised its DOE target from 2.5% to 3% and total payout ratio target from 30% or above to 40% or above, effective from the fiscal year ending December 2026. The fiscal year ending December 2026 dividend per share was increased by 3 yen to 15 yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Changes to Shareholder Return Policy (Increase in DOE Target and Total Payout Ratio Target) and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Oenon Holdings announced on October 29, 2026, an enhancement to its shareholder return policy effective from the fiscal year ending December 2026. The company raised its dividend on equity (DOE) target from 2.5% to 3% and its total payout ratio target from 30% or above to 40% or above.

The company has demonstrated sustained profit growth and strengthened financial position since announcing its Medium-Term Business Plan 2028 in November 2024. It has achieved DOE of 2.5% or higher for two consecutive fiscal periods from December 2024 onwards and expects to maintain this level in upcoming dividends. The company also implemented share buybacks for three consecutive periods from December 2024, with a combined total payout ratio of 40% or above over three years, exceeding its original plan target of 30% or above over five years.

Based on this track record and outlook, the board determined the company has reached a stage where it can sustain shareholder returns exceeding previous targets on a continuing basis. In connection with this policy change, Oenon increased its dividend per share forecast for the fiscal year ending December 2026 by 3 yen to 15 yen per share, up from the previously announced 12 yen.
